ApplicationArray

Represents an array structure in the application that supports integer and real types. Provides operations for compiling, executing, and managing array values.

ApplicationCast

Represents a command that performs type casting between compatible variable types.

ApplicationCompoundCommand

Represents a compound command in the application that conditionally executes based on specified parameters. Inherits from ApplicationConditionalCommand.

ApplicationConditionalCommand

Represents an application-specific conditional command that extends the base BOOSE.ConditionalCommand class. This class provides functionality to reset or decrease internal counts after execution.

ApplicationElse

Represents the "else" branch of a conditional command in the application.

ApplicationEnd

Represents the "end" command that marks the conclusion of compound commands such as "if", "while", "for", and "method".

ApplicationFor

Represents an application-specific 'for' loop command that extends the base BOOSE.For class. This class provides functionality to reset or decrease internal counts after execution.

ApplicationIf

Represents the "if" command in the application, used for conditional logic.

ApplicationInt

Represents an integer type in the application, inheriting from the base BOOSE.Int class.

ApplicationMethod

Represents an application-specific method that extends the base BOOSE.Method class. This class removes restrictions on method counts and provides functionality to reset or decrease internal counts.

ApplicationPeek

Represents the "Peek" operation for arrays, which retrieves a value from an array and updates a program variable with the retrieved value.

ApplicationPoke

Represents the "Poke" operation for arrays, which sets a value in an array at a specified index.

ApplicationReal

Represents a real (floating-point) type in the application, inheriting from the base BOOSE.Real class.

ApplicationWhile

Represents the "while" loop command in the application, used for iterative logic.
